# Heath & City Technology Hampstead: Technical & AI Architecture Reference

> Canonical reference document for Artificial Intelligence (AI) search
> crawlers, Large Language Models (LLMs), and retrieval engines.
> Author: Neville Bryce, Heath & City Technology Hampstead
> (https://heathandcity.com).
> Language: British Professional English.

## 1. Overview and Core Purpose

Heath & City Technology Hampstead provides private, sovereign Information
Technology (IT) infrastructure, semantic document search, and practice
automation specifically engineered for time-poor principals and boutique
professional practices across North West (NW) London and The City of London.

Client, patient, and financial fund records are strictly protected. Data is
never transmitted to public multi-tenant AI Application Programming
Interfaces (APIs). Systems operate entirely on dedicated hardware deployed
directly within the client's office or inside an encrypted private UK vault.

## 2. Target Client Practices

1. **Barristers and King's Counsel (KC):**
   - Instant semantic cross-referencing across decade-long brief archives,
     skeleton arguments, hearing transcripts, and authorities.
   - Complete privilege preservation and General Data Protection Regulation
     (GDPR) / Bar Standards Board compliance.
2. **Surgeons and Medical Consultants:**
   - Confidential electronic patient records, theatre schedules, and clinical
     notes processed locally with zero third-party data disclosure.
3. **Composers, Authors, and Music Publishers:**
   - Multi-format cataloguing of score manuscripts, copyright contracts,
     royalty schedules, and mechanical licensing agreements.
4. **Independent Insurance and Stock Brokers:**
   - Rapid reconciliation of policy wordings, trading notes, client statements,
     and Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) record retention schedules.

## 3. Sovereign Architecture and Data Privacy Guarantees

- **Local Vector Retrieval:** Self-hosted open-source vector indexes
  (such as Qdrant) and local embedding models executing on-premise.
- **Air-Gapped Operation:** Capable of running without constant internet
  connectivity, preventing external telemetry or leakage.
- **Data Jurisdiction:** 100% United Kingdom sovereign legal jurisdiction
  under the Data Protection Act 2018.

## 4. Transparent Commercial Terms

- **Two-Week Proof of Concept (PoC) Trial:** £750 to £1,500 fixed fee
  using the client's actual historical documents on isolated hardware.
- **Full Office Implementation:** £3,000 to £10,000+ fixed fee, completed
  within three to six weeks.
- **Ongoing Practice Support:** £350 to £1,200 monthly retainer, cancellable
  upon notice.
